name: story-youtube-script
description: Long-form YouTube scripts in one of six genres (business and finance, tech review, commentary, documentary, true crime, explainer): a router picks the genre from the brief's promise and evidence; the genre guide gives three hooks, a beat plan, a timestamped spoken script with bracketed cues written to the target length, and a retention map; four minutes or less uses a short-form mode. Text only, no paid calls; facts sourced or tagged for checking. Use when: write a YouTube script, a video essay, a documentary or true-crime narration, a tech review or explainer script, hooks and a retention plan for a long video, or the spoken script a faceless or presenter pipeline will voice. NOT for: ad, commercial or film-scene scripts (not offered here); a timed shot table for generated video (media-script-writer); clips or voice (media-video-generation, media-audio-generation); a finished faceless video (story-faceless-long, story-faceless-short); a presenter video (voice-presenter-video).
